## License and provenance

Poly Haven states that all assets on its site are CC0. Its license page is captured in `LICENSE-source.html`; live source: https://polyhaven.com/license. CC0 permits redistribution and commercial use without required attribution. Creator names and source links are retained voluntarily. Exact API metadata and publisher MD5s are in each asset's `source-info.json` and `source-files.json`; SHA-256 sums of all included files are in `SHA256SUMS`.

These are generic asset sources, not evidence of historically accurate Yugoslav design. Inspect scale, detail, collisions, material import, and RTS-camera readability before integration. Keep decorative props presentation-only and assess their navigation effect separately.
